avoid_when: Do not use as a storefront theme or theme catalog; storefront themes are distributed by inneranimalmedia-theme-store.
name: @inneranimalmedia/theme-scenes
purpose: Cross-product creative scene composition contracts, reusable scene templates and a CMS-compatible portable renderer. Not a storefront theme.
use_when: Compose reusable, brand-token-aware scenes from content blocks, media, routes and motion.
Expose PrimeTech-authored scene compositions as portable sections on site-scoped CMS pages.
Package reusable scene definitions as CMS scene artifacts without embedding tenant identity.
